# Online Calculators — Full Catalog

> Machine-readable index of all calculators, categories, and site metadata. Generated 2026-06-25. Canonical site: https://online-calculators.com

## Site Metadata

- name: Online Calculators
- url: https://online-calculators.com
- description: Fast, accurate, and free online calculators for finance, health, math, business, and unit conversion. EMI, SIP, BMI, GST, percentage, and 1000+ more calculators.
- operator: Nitin Kumar
- contact: onlinecalculatorsinfo@gmail.com
- github: https://github.com/nitinkanish/nitinkanish.github.io
- linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/onlinecalculators/
- stack: Jekyll, GitHub Pages, vanilla JavaScript (client-side calculators), SCSS, PWA
- analytics: Google Analytics 4 (G-BJLB2TWL8B), loaded only after cookie consent

## Architecture (for contributors)

- Calculator definitions: `_data/calculators.yml`
- Dashboard copy: `_data/dashboard_pages.yml`
- SEO titles: `_data/seo.yml`
- Long-form content: `_data/calc_content.yml`
- Forms: `_includes/calc-forms/{type}.html`
- Logic: `assets/js/calculators/{type}.js`
- Layout: `_layouts/calculator.html` (15-section dashboard)
- Regenerate pages: `ruby scripts/generate_pages.rb --force`
- Regenerate llms files: `ruby scripts/generate_llms_txt.rb`

## Disclaimers

- Health calculators (BMI, BMR, calorie, pregnancy) provide estimates only — not medical advice.
- Finance calculators (EMI, SIP, FD, mortgage) are projections — verify with your bank or advisor.
- GST calculator targets Indian tax slabs; mortgage calculator uses US-style amortization.
- No personal data is stored server-side; calculations run in the user browser.
